label: Theta.8 controls: heavenly first, contingent first, idle uncaused composite
paraphrase: Closed controls. (1) Heavenly first being: over Bool beings and Bool respects (true being, false a place), every potency of the contradictory, the simply incorruptible in act in substance, first beings simply incorruptible and in act in some respect, and non-overlap hold while a first being is in potency to a place, so act priority at a first being fails. (2) Contingent first being: every first being is in act in some respect while none is simply incorruptible. (3) A being in act in a place but not in being, in potency in being and simple, satisfies the restricted composition premise and falsifies both the unrestricted one and 'whatever is in act in some respect is in act in being'. (4) Idle uncaused composite first being: with Int times, now 0, one interpretation satisfies every premise of the three routes to the q.3 a.1 conclusion except the cause of composites and plenitude, with a first being composite, uncaused and in potency to a place at every time, never actualized. (5) Each of the six premises of the Theta.8 composition route and each of the five premises of the plenitude route is needed (omission models), and the plenitude route is not vacuous. (6) For every carrier: the composition premise gives its restriction to act in being; with STMT-ACTUALITY-ONLY-INSOFAR-AS-BEING the restriction gives it back, and 'every first being is in act in some respect' gives that every first being is in act in being. Statements about these interpretations and implications only.
